responsibility: Implements a target RTL pass that inserts USE operands for Epiphany instructions participating in mode switching. The pass scans insns for entities described by NUM_MODES_FOR_MODE_SWITCHING, queries epiphany_mode_needed, and invokes TARGET_INSERT_MODE_SWITCH_USE so affected insns explicitly reference the pseudo hard registers that model FP rounding or related mode state, then rescans dataflow. Its role is to make mode dependencies visible to later RTL analyses and optimization passes.
